terms: ## Conversational Texture The user asked for Authority-forced execution and audit discipline; this follow-up preserves that discipline by fixing the exact consistency gap discovered by audit.

## Key Insights This is not an arbitrary optimization. Lattice users consume the compiled CLI entrypoint, so stale dist artifacts make the completed story observably incomplete even when src is correct.

## Solution Tradeoffs Keep the follow-up narrow: rebuild or sync only the executable artifacts required for the already-approved source change, then prove the CLI output matches. Do not change scope gates or Authority semantics.
## Trigger Event On 2026-06-13, post-DONE audit of B-12f3 found that merged source guidance did not match executable dist output. Ref: B-12f3.

Real correctness issue found after DONE: packages/main/src contains the new guidance, but packages/main/dist/cli-engine.js and packages/main/dist/handlers/story-review.js still contain old text, so node packages/main/dist/cli.js and global lattice can show stale output.
Regenerate and verify executable CLI guidance artifacts for missing_scope_check
